cueSelection.rule: Greedy first three distinct normalized words in ascending ID order with pairwise-disjoint codes.

artifact.name: NeuroSphere formation
artifact.reset: Rest membrane, zero fast adaptation/activity, empty queues, input schedules start from adapters. Age and threshold retain their locked values.

weightAudit.definition: Association-phase events only. Inherited births retain their original absolute tick/time and a negative relative birth epoch. Age bins count time exposed to this phase, in this condition's epoch durations. Predictions are earliest continuous afferent arrivals plus native recurrent delays; not observed STDP, and omit inhibition/recurrent-driven spikes.
